title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 24
description:
At Jeminise, we offer this custom comforter set, perfect for baseball enthusiasts. This personalized bedding set allows you to celebrate your love for the game and create a unique space.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Ideal for baseball players, fans, and lovers, emphasizing determination.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features an environmental protection finishing process to maintain dye and prevent fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Made from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric, known for being soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight.
  • Durable Filling: Contains Whole-Piece Microfiber Filling with tight stitching to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat for best results.
  • Thoughtful Gift: Perfect gift for men, women, moms, dads, for occasions like Valentine's, Mother's Day, Father's Day, and Christmas.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Sets
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Fill Material Microfiber Filling
Selected Design Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Set Name Personalized Baseball Bedding Set
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Seasons All
Special Feature Breathable
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 400
